errors.text: The proposed Fe/Co addition does not reconstruct the target intervention of rapid quenching to stabilize an fcc–C14 dual-phase microstructure.
A non-magnetic alloy is not a scientifically appropriate matched baseline for coercivity, which is meaningful only after magnetic hysteresis exists.
No specific mechanism connects Fe/Co addition to increased coercivity; creating magnetic domains or magnetization alone does not imply greater domain-wall pinning or magnetic anisotropy.
No directly applicable prior evidence supports the hypothesis.
The proposed experiment confounds magnetic-element content, phase constitution, and magnetic ordering without structural or phase-matched controls.
